title: Oracle has no read-side staleness check and the monotonic-update guard is commented out
root_cause: Oracle.updatePrice's monotonic timestamp guard is commented out and Oracle.getPrice has no max-age, so stale or rolled-back prices are used by Risk's margin math indefinitely.
attacker_entrypoint: OraclePlugin price tick path / operator delay (price feeder is trusted; the missing guard is contract-level)
attacker_capabilities: operator delay/failure or a reordered/rolled-back price tick
out_of_scope_risks: relies on trusted operator/admin behavior (program trust model dependent)

severity_justification.worst_case: Stale price drives wrong liquidations / margin => fund loss under operator delay or reorg.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Robustness gap; impact bounded by operator liveness in the happy path.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: updatePrice price 1 @ OLDER ts => accepted (no monotonic guard)
getPrice returns rolled-back 1; warp 10 years => still exist=true (no staleness)

state_transition.after: price 1 @ older ts accepted; 10-year-old price still exist=true

asset_delta: Margin/liquidation decisions can run on stale/rolled-back prices (mispriced solvency).
false_positive_risks: severity/scope depend on the official program trust model
invalidating_conditions: program may treat operator/admin actions as out of scope

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: bounds ingestion only; stored price has no read-side freshness and can be reordered

triager_summary: Oracle has no read-side staleness check and the monotonic-update guard is commented out — PoC passing (PASS: older-timestamp price accepted; ancient price still reads exist=true).
vrt_category: Insufficient Cryptography / Insecure Design → Business Logic Errors (oracle price consumed with no read-side staleness check; monotonic-update guard disabled)  ·  Sensitive Data / data-authenticity: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
